title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana and log-shipping for Private installs
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Private (VPC/on-prem) installs must include a repeatable, supportable observability stack by default. Operators deploying Private must be able to install Prometheus/Grafana, shipping of application logs to customer logging endpoints (syslog/ELK/Splunk), and a baseline set of dashboards and alerts that match Hosted semantics. This PR automates the observability stack in the installer and provides Terraform + Helm artefacts for private deployments.

Summary of changes: created a new terraform module (terraform/modules/observability) to provision K8s resources and optional cloud-managed services, added a new Helm umbrella chart charts/private-observability that packages: Prometheus (kube-prometheus-stack) with opinionated values, Grafana with pre-provisioned dashboards (redwood-service, model-serving, infra), Fluent Bit daemonset manifest with outputs for syslog/HTTP/Elasticsearch/Splunk, and a small operator job to seed PrometheusServiceMonitors and AlertmanagerConfig. Updated the private installer (installer/helm-values and installer/README) to include --enable-observability flag and rollout/rollback hooks. Added migration docs and an upgrade test harness (perf-canary/observability-upgrade-test) to validate zero-downtime upgrades.

Files changed (high level):
- terraform/modules/observability/* (new) - module + variables + example usage
- charts/private-observability/Chart.yaml, values.yaml, templates/* - helm chart packaging prometheus/grafana/fluentbit and k8s RBAC
- installer/helm-values/observability.yaml - default values for private installs
- installer/upgrade-scripts/observability-migrate.sh - idempotent migration for older installs
- perf-canary/observability-upgrade-test - e2e harness to validate rolling upgrades and config drift
- docs/private/observability.md - operator guide and troubleshooting

Commits: "init observability terraform module"; "helm chart: add private-observability umbrella"; "fluentbit: add outputs + templated parsers"; "installer: enable flag + hooks"; "docs: observability operator guide"; "tests: add upgrade canary".

Testing/CI: CI ran full unit/lint and the integration e2e on the private-installer matrix. The first run had a flaky Grafana provisioning step (timeout) which caused a rerun; subsequent CI passed. The perf canary tests were run against GKE prod-like cluster (k8s 1.26) in our staging and validated: Prometheus scrape targets for core services, Grafana dashboards render, Fluent Bit forwards logs to an internal ELK endpoint. No alerts triggered in smoke tests.

Upgrade and rollback notes: The installer supports in-place upgrades. observability-migrate.sh will back up existing Prometheus/Alertmanager configmaps and apply new CRDs in a safe order. The Helm chart includes pre-upgrade and post-upgrade hooks to ensure ServiceMonitors are created before Prometheus upgrades. Rollback will restore backed up configmaps and re-apply previous chart revision. Documented in docs/private/observability.md.

Backward compatibility: Default behaviour is opt-in via --enable-observability to avoid changing existing customer clusters. For customers who enable the flag, we provide a migration path; no breaking changes to existing manifests unless they opt in.

Review conversation (high level timeline):
- Jorge: "Can we avoid shipping the entire kube-prometheus-stack with default persistence enabled? For small on-prem clusters persistence can OOM the node." -> Action: made persistent volume claims optional via values (persistence.enabled=false default for tiny clusters) and added sizing recommendations in docs.
- Samir: "We need RBAC review for the fluent-bit role and ensure it only reads pod metadata required for logs." -> Action: tightened RBAC rules, replaced broad get/list/watch verbs with targeted RoleRules and documented least-privilege in README.
- Elena: "Add e2e that simulates upgrade with AlertmanagerConfig to verify no alert spam on migration." -> Action: added perf-canary/observability-upgrade-test that runs upgrade scenario and asserts alerting silence windows.
- CI initially failed on grafana provisioning timeouts; I increased readiness probe timeouts and added a retry around the grafana dashboard provisioning script. Rerun passed; Jorge approved. Samir approved after RBAC changes; Elena left an approval comment after observing canary run.

Merge outcome: CI green on rerun, approvals from 3 reviewers, merged via squash.

Related: Linear ENG-2143 (observability baseline for Private), ENG-2178 (installer rollout hooks), SUP-987 (customer request for log forwarding to Splunk).
notes: This PR was coordinated with the SRE and installer teams. We intentionally keep observability opt-in until we've completed extra scalability tests. Next steps: add Grafana alerts catalog, hook into Console for playback of historical alerts, and add optional managed backends for customers who want cloud managed storage.
release_notes: Added opt-in observability automation for Private installs: terraform module, helm chart for Prometheus/Grafana, Fluent Bit log-shipping, dashboards and upgrade tooling. Not enabled by default. See docs/private/observability.md for operator instructions.
